[[Techzone 56060]] See [[#Subsidiaries|Subsidiaries]] | module = | website = {{URL|http://erosplc.com/|Eros International}} | footnotes = | coordinates = | slogan = }} '''Eros International''' is an Indian motion picture [[Film production|production]] and [[Film distribution|distribution]] company, based and originated in [[Mumbai]], India. Founded by Arjan Lulla in 1977, it is one of the leading production and distribution companies in India.{{Cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/eros-international-media/|title=Asia's 200 Best Under A Billion List|date=17 July 2017|work=Forbes|access-date=1 July 2018|language=en}} Currently, his sons [[Kishore Lulla]]{{Cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesasia/2014/04/30/kishore-lulla-brings-light-to-bollywood/#66432c84658d|title=Kishore Lulla Brings Light to Bollywood|date=May 2014|work=Forbes|access-date=1 July 2018|language=en}} and Sunil Lulla manage the company. It is a subsidiary of [[Eros Media World]], formed in 2020, which was formerly known as [[Eros International plc|Eros International Plc]] and subsequently [[Eros STX Global Corporation|ErosSTX Global]].{{Cite web |date=2020-09-11 |title=Eros International Plc Announces Corporate Name Change to Eros STX Global Corporation |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20200911005258/en/Eros-International-Plc-Announces-Corporate-Name-Change-to-Eros-STX-Global-Corporation |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=www.businesswire.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2022-05-25 |title=Eros Announces Corporate Name Change to Eros Media World PLC |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220525005502/en/Eros-Announces-Corporate-Name-Change-to-Eros-Media-World-PLC |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=www.businesswire.com |language=en}} Eros co-produces, acquires and distributes Indian films in multiple formats worldwide, including theatrical, television syndication and digital platforms.{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/eros-international-media-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-32234.cms|title=Company History - Eros International Media Ltd|website=The Economic Times|publisher=Times Group|access-date=1 July 2018}} Eros has over 12,000 films in its library which include Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and other regional language films. ==History== In 1977, Arjan Lulla started the company. In 1981, he founded the company ''Jupiter Enterprise'' with Mr. Kishore Lulla and Ms. Bhagibhai Lulla. On 19 August 1994 ''Rishima International Pvt Ltd'' was founded. It was a private limited company. Through its subsidiary "Eros International Films", the company produced and distributed films. On 1 April 1999, the company acquired the entire Jupiter Enterprise. Their first jointly produced film was Waqt (2005). On 25 July 2000, the name was changed to ''Eros Multimedia Private Limited''. The name was again changed to ''Eros International Pvt Ltd'' on 20 November 2008. On 16 September 2009, the company was converted into a public limited company and on 18 November, the name was changed to the present name ''Eros International Media Ltd''.{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/erosinternationalmedia/history/EIM?classic=true|title=Eros International Media > Company History > Media & Entertainment > Company History of Eros International Media - BSE: 533261, NSE: EROSMEDIA|website=www.moneycontrol.com}} In 2010, Eros International Media Limited was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) in India.{{cite web|url=https://www.nyse.com/network/article/Eros-Bollywood-Thrills|title=Bollywood Thrills - Eros International - NYSE|website=www.nyse.com|access-date=27 April 2015|archive-date=27 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327091002/https://www.nyse.com/network/article/Eros-Bollywood-Thrills|url-status=dead}} The name Eros was chosen after the [[Eros|Greek god of love]].{{Cite web|title=Rich rewards of a dual identity|url=https://www.ft.com/content/6afc9e82-44f5-11dc-82f5-0000779fd2ac|last=Willman|first=John|date=7 August 2007|website=Financial Times|url-status=live|archive-url=https://archive.today/20200430171529/https://www.ft.com/content/6afc9e82-44f5-11dc-82f5-0000779fd2ac|archive-date=30 April 2020|access-date=30 April 2020}} ==Subsidiaries== ===Current=== * [[Colour Yellow Productions]] (50% share) * Copsale * Digicine * Eros Animation * Eros International Films * Eros International Distribution (99.8% share) * Eros Music Publishing * Eyeqube Studios (99.9% share) * [[Techzone 56060]] ===Former=== *[[Ayngaran International]] (51% share) *[[HBO_Asia#HBO_South_Asia|HBO Hits (India)]] (50% share) ===Joint ventures=== *Reliance Eros Productions (joint Venture with [[Reliance Industries]]) ==Partnerships== In 2008, Eros International made a deal with [[Universal Music Group]] to make a joint-venture to promote pop music to India. The agreement was announced by [[Kishore Lulla]] and Max Hole, President of Universal Music Asia Pacific Region and Executive Vice President, Universal Music Group International (UMGI) on 10 December though the joint venture was officiated with a contractual signing on 18 November. Rajat Kakar, managing director of Universal Music India was appointed as the chairperson and Sunil Lulla and [[Jyoti Deshpande]], former COO of Eros International Group, are on the board of directors.{{Cite news|url=https://www.universalmusic.com/universal-music-and-eros-international-announce-joint-venture-to-globally-promote-indian-pop-talent/|title=Universal Music and Eros International announce joint-venture to globally promote Indian pop talent.|date=10 December 2008|work=UMG|access-date=1 July 2018|language=en-US|archive-date=27 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180627144815/https://www.universalmusic.com/universal-music-and-eros-international-announce-joint-venture-to-globally-promote-indian-pop-talent/|url-status=dead}} That same year, the company formed a joint venture with [[Lionsgate Films|Lionsgate]]. The two companies would also co-produce films with budgets ranging from $10 to 20 million. Eros and Lionsgate also received access to each other's library, with Eros planning to air Lionsgate's TV shows such as ''[[Weeds (TV series)|Weeds]]'' and ''[[Mad Men]]'' and Lionsgate distributing some of Eros' Hindi films in North America such as ''[[Om Shanti Om]]'', ''[[Gandhi, My Father]]'' and ''[[Eklavya: The Royal Guard]]''.{{cite web|title=Eros ties up with Lionsgate|website=[[The Financial Express (India)|The Financial Express]]|first=Sudipta|last=Datta|date=20 May 2008|access-date=22 July 2022|url= https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/eros-ties-up-with-lionsgate/312352/}} ==Filmography== ===Films produced and distributed by Eros International=== {{main|List of films released by Eros International}} ===Film music and soundtrack produced by Eros Music=== {{main|Eros Music}} ==Awards== {| class="wikitable" |- ! Eros International  is an Indian motion picture production and distribution company, based and originated in Mumbai, India. Founded by Arjan Lulla in 1977, it is one of the leading production and distribution companies in India. Currently, his sons Kishore Lulla and Sunil Lulla manage the company. It is a subsidiary of Eros Media World, formed in 2020, which was formerly known as Eros International Plc and subsequently ErosSTX Global.
Eros co-produces, acquires and distributes Indian films in multiple formats worldwide, including theatrical, television syndication and digital platforms.
Eros has over 12,000 films in its library which include Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and other regional language films.
